core_meaning.primary_meaning: Merve is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Marwa (Turkish form)”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Merve corresponds to the Arabic form مَرْوَة (Arabic root م ر و (m-r-w); مَرْوَة (Marwa)). Its core sense is merve; marwa (turkish form). Merve is the Turkish form of Arabic مَرْوَة (Marwa), the name of a hill near Mecca mentioned in the Quran.

persian.name: مروه
persian.long_meaning: Merve (مروه) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن مروه، کوه صفا و مروه است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

arabic.name: مَرْوَة
